entities.name: Évelyne Mpoudi Ngolé

entities.summary: Evelyne Sono Epoh Mpoudi Ngolé, also Ngollé, is a Cameroonian French-language author and educator. Her first novel, Sous la cendre le feu, was published in 1990.
